GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths on fence, railed to 4.5 Lengths turning, couldn't come on in Straight # never a factor
Jumped Ok No Pace On as expected let stride Settled Down 2nd Outside 1 Lengths off leader/winner happy to stalk, Under Pressure x 600m, gone x Turn (t/t/ag) # struggled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Fractious in the horse stall area; and behind the gates, kicked out contacting another runner. Warning for its pre-race behaviour. Raced wide early, before being allowed to stride to sit off lead near the 1200m. Rdr reported had to make use of gelding early to avoid being caught wide & when placed under pressure in the straight, mount failed to respond, adding the efforts early to obtain a position may have had an affect on the horse’s performance-further added gelding may be better suited to lower grade races. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover Just off speed 2 Lengths 1000m, rolled back inside soon after Straightening Up but Hard Ridden , weakened in Straight off tough run, nasal strip again # tough run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early. Raced wide throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Wide out Not Bustled though settled down third last & a little Wide had cover 5 Lengths (1200m), well back & widest into the Straight last & no hope, didn't improve # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 400m, the near side winker detached from the bridle. Rdr reported gelding failed to back up from its recent start at Ipswich August 7th.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (ex Brian Azel) Jumped ok Caught deep improving 5 Lengths (1200m), working hard moving to third approaching Turn , Straightened Up now all out still there, fought on well to the line (t-control bit again/t-tie off again) # wide/worked/game
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: In the straight laid in obliging Rdr to correct gelding on several occasions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, shifted in and Settled Down 7 Lengths 2-3 wide, 3 Wide from 900m, Made Some Ground to 6 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported it was inclined to hang in from 500m and proved difficult to ride out in his normal manner.] # mostly Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in at the start & bumped RUGBY. Raced wide without cover for the majority. Jcky Yoshida reported his mount was inclined to hang in from the 500m, which proved difficult for him to ride BRINGME out in his normal manner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out & Settled Down 8 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then Lost Ground in Straight # never featured

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 3.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards permitted jockey to ride 1.0kg overweight. Raced keenly early stages.] # no excuses
Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 10 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to turn, improved 2 Lengths or So in straight. [Stewards permitted jockey to ride 0.5kg overweight.] # never featured
Jumped just ok Wide out settled down off rail last few 8 Lengths (1200m), 3 Wide with cover 5 Lengths off the lead 700, cornered widest & ran on well Under Whip just missing out # back/wide/ran on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted pre-race. Began awkwardly. Raced wide for the majority. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, shaken up at the 500m, trailed 5 Lengths rail turning, shifted out 3 Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground in Straight # Had its chances
Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 10 Lengths on fence, railed to 8 Lengths turning, Lost Ground in Straight # never featured
